name: lerobot-cad-studio
description: Interactive 3D-print design and MuJoCo evaluation for LeRobot robots. Builds a static site (site/) for GitHub Pages.

scripts.test:unit: node tools/build/build.mjs >/dev/null && for f in $(find tools/tests -name '*.test.mjs' | sort); do echo "== $f"; node --test "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.cad:test: uv run --extra cad python -m pytest tools/tests/cad -q
scripts.sim:test: node tools/build/build.mjs >/dev/null && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tools/tests/features/sim-*.test.mjs tools/tests/sim/*.test.mjs && uv run --extra sim python -m pytest tools/tests/sim tools/tests/build -q
scripts.sim:check: npm run sim:export && npm run sim:lab && uv run --extra sim python tools/sim/check.py out/work/sim/lab
scripts.sim:video: node tools/sim/export.mjs --robot lekiwi-pincopen --visual --lab --out out/work/sim/lab && uv run --extra sim python tools/render/film/video.py out/work/sim/lab
scripts.sim:video:teleop: node tools/sim/export.mjs --robot lekiwi-pincopen --visual --out out/work/sim/lab && node tools/sim/run-teleop.mjs out/work/sim/lab --script tools/sim/lab-tour.json && uv run --extra sim python tools/render/film/video.py out/work/sim/lab --ctrl out/work/sim/lab/teleop/ctrl.f32
scripts.render: python3 tools/render/fetch_assets.py && node tools/sim/export.mjs --robot lekiwi-pincopen --visual --lab --out out/work/render/hero/lab && nice -n 5 uv run --extra sim python tools/render/hero.py
scripts.render:draft: node tools/sim/export.mjs --robot lekiwi-pincopen --visual --lab --out out/work/render/hero/lab && uv run --extra sim python tools/render/film/video.py out/work/render/hero/lab --campath tools/render/shots.json
scripts.render:thumbs: node tools/render/thumbs.mjs && python3 tools/render/blender.py thumb --in out/work/render/thumbs
scripts.render:test: uv run --extra sim python -m pytest tools/tests/render -q
scripts.render:test:fast: uv run --extra sim python -m pytest tools/tests/render -q -m "not blender and not gl and not slow"
